title: How to List Tasks with Claude MCP and Medux
description: Learn how to use Claude MCP and Medux to list media tasks created by the authenticated user, including setup, request fields, tool approval, and results.

prompt: Use Medux to run List Tasks. Review the required inputs, call medux_list_tasks, wait for the result if a task is returned, and report the output clearly.
